description: This header file defines the interface for rbus buffer management, including creation, destruction, reading, writing, and encoding/decoding operations for a circular buffer used in remote bus communication. It also declares functions for handling value types, filters, and various data serialization routines.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Create
methods.description: Initializes a new rbusBuffer for use.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Destroy
methods.description: Releases resources associated with an rbusBuffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Reserve
methods.description: Ensures the buffer has enough space for additional data.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Write
methods.description: Writes raw data into the buffer.

methods.description: Serializes a typed value with length into the buffer.

methods.description: Writes a boolean value as TLV into the buffer.
